title: Fubini on the triangle: ∫_{(σ,ρ]} F′(t)(∫_{(t,ρ]} e)dt = ∫_{(σ,ρ]} e(F − F(σ)) (parent Step 9)
statement: Let e, F, F′: ℝ → ℝ and σ, ρ ∈ ℝ. Assume e and F′ are Lebesgue integrable on (σ, ρ] and F(t) = F(σ) + ∫_{(σ,t]} F′(τ)dτ for every t ∈ [σ, ρ]. Then (a) s ↦ e(s)(F(s) − F(σ)) is Lebesgue integrable on (σ, ρ]; (b) t ↦ F′(t)·∫_{(t,ρ]} e(τ)dτ is Lebesgue integrable on (σ, ρ]; and (c) ∫_{(σ,ρ]} F′(t)(∫_{(t,ρ]} e(τ)dτ)dt = ∫_{(σ,ρ]} e(s)(F(s) − F(σ))ds.
lean_statement: ∀ (e F F' : ℝ → ℝ) (σ ρ : ℝ), IntegrableOn e (Ioc σ ρ) → IntegrableOn F' (Ioc σ ρ) → (∀ t ∈ Icc σ ρ, F t = F σ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ t, F' τ) → IntegrableOn (fun s ↦ e s * (F s - F σ)) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun t ↦ F' t * ∫ τ in Ioc t ρ, e τ) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ ∫ t in Ioc σ ρ, F' t * ∫ τ in Ioc t ρ, e τ = ∫ s in Ioc σ ρ, e s * (F s - F σ)
